opening.argument: The video gives viewers a practical route into upcoming ICOs, beginning with instructions to participate in BATS and transfer Ethereum before the sale. Viewers are told that, when the sale starts, they receive the address for depositing Ethereum, and that pressing send will purchase the tokens. The pitch adds speculative appreciation: day-one speculators may “ramp that thing up” by about 100-200%, while immediate exchange availability is presented as a reason for that prospect. Although the speaker recommends research and says the project is not definitely a scam, those qualifications do not change the solicitation to prepare funds for a token purchase. The evidence does not establish a completed transaction, guaranteed return or verified loss.
